question: Select the correct spelling of a word meaning “one who avoids hard work”.
solution:
The correct answer is** option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The correct spelling of the word is 'Sluggard'.**

__
 
• **'Sluggard'** is a noun meaning 'a lazy, sluggish person or one who avoids hard work'. **(आलसी व्यक्ति)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• The sluggard refused to help clean the house, preferring to lounge on the sofa all day.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Sluggard'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand why the other options are incorrect - **

 
• **Sluggurd - **This is a misspelling of the word 'Sluggard'.
 
• **Slugard -** This is also a misspelling, as it omits an essential 'g' in the word.
 
• **Sluggerd -** This is another incorrect spelling, which adds an unnecessary 'e'.
